theater: 多瑙河下游魯塞克至貝爾格萊德

battle.name: 第七次俄土戰爭
battle.theater: 多瑙河下游魯塞克至貝爾格萊德
battle.brief: 1806年10月，鄂圖曼指俄國支持塞爾維亞起義而宣戰，戰線自摩爾多瓦拉至貝爾格萊德。巴格拉季昂1807年攻下魯塞克；庫圖佐夫1811年策動多瑙河三路渡河，聯同塞爾維亞義軍於斯洛博齊亞擊潰鄂軍主力，1812年因拿破崙入侵而議和。卡面的西班牙方陣盾屬16世紀長矛火繩槍時代，本戰線上並無此盾。

kit.name: 西班牙方陣盾
kit.history: 一面方盾撐住一整排人。無敵兵團的方陣靠它，也靠後面那排火繩槍。

countries: 這場戰爭是俄羅斯帝國與鄂圖曼帝國在1806年10月至1812年5月之間的直接交鋒，主戰場在多瑙河下游、摩爾多瓦與瓦拉幾亞一線，並把塞爾維亞等巴爾幹地區拖入其中。俄國一方由皇帝亞歷山大一世統籌，前線分作幾個戰區：駐摩爾多瓦的俄軍由巴格拉季昂將軍指揮，1807年越過普魯特河反攻時攻下魯塞克；1811年集結於多瑙河的全軍由庫圖佐夫元帥統一指揮，麾下有維特根斯坦、蘭格隆、薩肯等師旅，黑海方面則由艦隊司令謝尼亞溫負責；聖彼得堡另設專門的「塞爾維亞委員會」，由亞歷山德爾·斯圖爾扎主持，負責向塞爾維亞起義者輸送金錢、槍械與顧問。俄軍麾下有大量哥薩克騎兵與克里米亞弓兵充當偵察、追擊與擾亂。鄂圖曼一方在蘇丹塞利姆三世治下由樞密院掌權，塞利姆帕夏以卡普丹帕夏身分坐鎮維丁，馬哈茂德帕夏掌鄂圖曼魯梅利，於斯帕夏、埃魯茲魯姆帕夏等各省總督分守要地；除新軍「尼扎姆-傑迪德」與正規師團外，大量依靠德利、賽義曼等非正規騎兵與散兵，1807年後更僱用英法歐洲軍官組成歐洲式營，其中由英國軍官羅賓遜等人訓練的穆法基特營最為人知。第三方包括取得塞爾維亞起義主導權的塞爾維亞義軍、先後調停此案的英國、1807年以提爾西特條約與俄國結盟的法國、北方迫使俄軍分兵的瑞典，以及被徵糧徵兵的瓦拉幾亞與摩爾多瓦兩公國。
countriesEn: This war was a direct clash between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire between October 1806 and May 1812. The main theatre lay along the lower Danube, in Moldavia and Wallachia, and it dragged the Serbian lands of the Balkans into the fighting. On the Russian side the emperor was Alexander I, and the front was split into several theatres of operations: the Russian army in Moldavia under General Pyotr Bagration, which crossed the Prut in 1807 and took Ruse; the whole army assembled on the Danube in 1811 under Field Marshal Mikhail Kutuzov, with the corps of Wittgenstein, Langeron and Saken beneath him and, at sea, the fleet commander Senyavin; and in St Petersburg a special Serbian Committee under Alexander Sturdza, responsible for funneling money, firearms and advisers to the Serbian insurgents. Large numbers of Cossack cavalry and Crimean bashibazouks served the Russians for scouting, pursuit and harassment. The Ottoman side was governed, under Sultan Selim III, by the Sublime Porte: Selim Pasha sat at Vidin in the capacity of Kapudan Pasha, Mahmud Pasha held Rumelia, and the pashas of Yanina, Erzurum and the other provinces held their own districts; besides the reformed New Army, the Nizam-i Cedid, and the regular battalions, the Ottomans relied heavily on irregular cavalry and loose troops such as the deli and the seymen, and after 1807 they hired European-officered units of European style, of which the Mufakkit battalion trained by British officers such as Robinson is the best known. Third parties included the Serbian insurgents who seized the initiative in the rising, Britain, which mediated in turn, France, bound to Russia by the Treaty of Tilsit in 1807, Sweden, which forced Russia to divide her forces in the north, and the Danubian principalities of Wallachia and Moldavia, whose soil and grain were quartered by both armies.
people: 一場橫跨五年半的戰爭，最終決定走向的並非某一場會戰，而是幾個關鍵人物的反覆抉擇。俄國皇帝亞歷山大一世把塞爾維亞問題視為打開黑海門戶的槓桿，任由斯圖爾扎在聖彼得堡主持對義軍的援助，並批准在1806年接受開戰的風險；執行層面則是庫圖佐夫，他在1807年隨主力進入瓦拉幾亞、在1811年以多瑙河為軸心策劃渡河作戰，又在得知拿破崙入侵後不得不抽身北上，最後在布加勒斯特議和。巴格拉季昂是1807年反攻的尖刀，他於六月清晨藉霧奇襲於斯帕夏的營壘，奠定魯塞克之勝；列普寧親王率領的俄軍志願兵團則在塞爾維亞境內與卡拉喬爾季並肩作戰，促成1806年底貝爾格萊德的攻佔。塞爾維亞方面，卡拉喬爾季·彼得羅維奇是起義的象徵，他的被廢黜（1805年改立塞利姆帕夏）直接引爆戰端；米洛什·奧布倫諾維奇此時是起義軍中的對立派，1815年再起義時才真正掌權。鄂圖曼方面，塞利姆帕夏與馬哈茂德帕夏掌握資源，於斯帕夏在魯塞克與福克沙尼兩戰的失利令其威信掃地；法國軍事代表塞巴斯蒂亞尼與英國軍官羅賓遜先後介入鄂軍的訓練與編制，提議改用歐陸式縱隊與營制，卻未能扭轉戰局。黑海方面，謝尼亞溫在阿索斯與滕達拉兩場海戰中擊毀鄂軍分艦隊，是這場戰爭中少數能靠艦隊直接決定戰局的交鋒。
peopleEn: What decided the course of a war lasting five and a half years was not any single battle but the repeated choices of a handful of men. Alexander I of Russia saw the Serbian question as the lever that might open the Black Sea to his fleet, allowed Sturdza in St Petersburg to run the aid to the insurgents, and accepted the risk of war in 1806. At the level of execution stood Kutuzov, who marched into Wallachia with the main body in 1807, planned the crossings of the Danube around 1811, had to pull out to the north when the news of Napoleon's invasion came, and finally negotiated the peace at Bucharest. Bagration was the spearhead of the 1807 counter-offensive, striking at Yusuf Pasha's camp in the morning mist of June and winning the day at Ruse; Prince Repnin's Russian volunteer corps fought shoulder to shoulder with Karadjordje inside Serbia and was instrumental in the capture of Belgrade at the end of 1806. On the Serbian side Karadjordje Petrovic was the emblem of the rising, and his removal in 1805, when Selim Pasha was installed in his place, lit the fuse directly; Milos Obrenovic belonged to the opposing faction within the insurgents and only took power with the rising of 1815. On the Ottoman side Selim Pasha and Mahmud Pasha controlled the resources, and the defeats of Yusuf Pasha at Ruse and at Focsani destroyed his authority; the French military representative Sebastiani and the British officer Robinson were brought in to train and reorganize the Ottoman army, proposing continental formations and drill, but could not turn the course of the war. At sea, Senyavin's victories at Athos and at Tendra destroyed Ottoman squadron after Ottoman squadron, and these were the few engagements of the whole war decided directly by warships.
kits: 卡面這面西班牙方陣盾屬於16世紀的長矛與火繩槍方陣：木框蒙皮，圓而微凸，徑約半米，兵卒以短矛列陣前進時用它護住身體，抵擋手槍與火繩槍的第一輪齊射，也靠它承受方陣前線的撞擊。這種盾在17世紀後隨方陣制度瓦解而退出一線軍備，1806年的西班牙軍在半島上尚未採用任何大型身盾，更不可能把西班牙方陣盾帶到多瑙河東岸，本戰役現場並沒有這面盾。真正出現在1806至1812年多瑙河戰線的裝備是另一套體系：俄軍步兵用燧發滑膛槍（褐色貝松型與莫斯科維型）配刺刀，射手另有較輕的步槍；哥薩克持長矛式騎槍、彎刀與手槍，龍騎兵用卡賓槍，近衛與擲彈兵以輕炮與六磅砲支援，砲兵配野戰砲、臼砲與獨角獸砲，渡河依靠舟橋縱列與工程兵搭設的浮橋。鄂軍步槍以燧發與火繩為主，野戰砲數量有限，須仰賴安納托利亞方向的駱駝與馬匹馱運，河流運輸與攻城砲隊的補充極慢；近戰仍以弧形佩刀、短彎刀與火手槍為主，德利與賽義曼以長身火繩槍射擊後突擊。近似盾牌的傳統並未完全消失：零星記述與畫像顯示巴爾幹的非正規步兵仍偶用小型圓木盾，但這與西班牙方陣盾並無直接的譜系關係。
kitsEn: The Spanish tercio shield on the card belongs to the age of pike and shot in the sixteenth century: a wooden frame covered with hide, round and slightly convex, about half a metre across, carried by pikemen as they advanced in column so as to cover the body against the first volley of pistols and matchlock muskets, and to bear the shock of the front rank. The type fell out of first-line service as the tercio system was broken up in the seventeenth century; the Spanish army in 1806, fighting in the Peninsula, used no large body shield of any kind, and still less carried a Spanish tercio shield to the eastern bank of the Danube. This shield was not present in the war. What stood on the Danube front between 1806 and 1812 belonged to a different order of equipment: Russian infantry carried flintlock smoothbore muskets, brown Bess and Muscovite patterns, with bayonets, and lighter muskets for the skirmishers; Cossacks bore lance guns, sabres and pistols, dragoons carbines, while the guards and grenadiers were supported by light guns and six-pounders, the artillery equipped with field pieces, howitzers and unicorns, and the river crossings were made with pontoon trains and floating bridges built by the engineer troops. The Ottoman infantry was armed mainly with flintlock and matchlock muskets, its artillery was limited in number, and it relied on horses and camels out of Anatolia for supply, so that river transport and the siege train arrived slowly; at close quarters men still fought with curved sabres, the kilic, short yatagans and tinder-box pistols, while the deli and the seymen shot with long matchlock muskets before charging. The tradition of the shield had not wholly vanished: scattered records and images show small round wooden shields still used by irregular infantry in the Balkans, but these have no direct genealogical tie to the Spanish tercio shield.
tactics: 俄土雙方在多瑙河下游的作戰方式，六年之間換了幾種形態。鄂軍1806年秋季越過普魯特河、以多路縱隊向基什尼夫與摩爾多瓦內地展開劫掠式進攻，靠騎兵速度與散兵驅逐俄軍前哨；俄軍初期採戰略退卻，把兵馬收攏在據點與河流之間，之後再集中兵力反擊。1807年六月巴格拉季昂在魯塞克附近的戰役是全戰爭最典型的正面攻堅：以晨霧掩護，步兵縱隊分兩翼同時攻擊鄂軍營壘，砲兵先行發射覆蓋，騎兵在鄂軍潰散時追擊衝鋒，營壘連同火藥車被毀，於斯帕夏僅以數百騎殘部脫身。1811年的作戰則完全不同：庫圖佐夫把多瑙河當成軸線，計劃三路渡河——主力由吉爾吉烏方向渡過，另有部隊往南，另以塞爾維亞義軍在鐵門一帶渡河插入鄂軍側後；渡河之後不急於攻堅，而是切斷鄂軍與魯塞克、錫利斯特拉之間的聯繫，逼其向華沙一帶退卻，再在斯洛博齊亞以縱隊追擊，把一支大軍在行軍縱隊中逐段吃掉。配合行動的是黑海分艦隊封鎖鄂軍海上補給，以及溯多瑙河而上的艦隊在下游切斷退路。1812年俄軍一度圍困魯塞克，靠架設浮橋與修築攻城砲壘步步為營，卻因歐洲戰局急轉而放棄。海戰方面，俄國以巡防艦隊在阿索斯與滕達拉橫掃鄂軍分隊，採兩翼鉗制後由中央縱列突進的打法。
tacticsEn: The ways in which the two sides fought on the lower Danube changed several times over six years. In the autumn of 1806 the Ottoman army crossed the Prut and advanced in several columns toward Kishinev and the interior of Moldavia, raiding as it went, using the speed of its cavalry and loose troops to drive off the Russian outposts; the Russians answered with a strategic withdrawal, drawing men and horses together between fortresses and rivers, and only counter-attacked after concentrating their strength. The battle near Ruse in June 1807 was the most typical frontal assault of the whole war: under cover of the morning mist, infantry columns attacked the Ottoman camp simultaneously from two wings, the artillery opened fire to cover them, and the cavalry charged into the rout, the camp and its ammunition wagons being destroyed, while Yusuf Pasha escaped with a few hundred horsemen. The warfare of 1811 was different in every respect: Kutuzov took the Danube as his axis and planned three crossings, the main body fording above Giurgiu, a second force moving to the south, and the Serbian insurgents crossing near the Iron Gates to fall upon the Ottoman flank; once across, he did not hurry into a siege but cut the Ottoman lines of communication between Ruse and Silistra, forced the Ottoman army to withdraw toward the Wallachian plain, and then caught it in column on the march at Slobozia, destroying it piecemeal. Cooperating with this were the Black Sea detachments sealing the Ottoman sea communications and the river squadron moving up the Danube to cut the retreat below. In 1812 the Russians invested Ruse, bridging the river and building siege batteries by degrees, but abandoned the siege when the war in Europe turned. At sea the Russians swept the Ottoman detachments at Athos and at Tendra, using a movement that clamped the enemy with two wings and then drove through the centre in column.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。戰爭自1806年10月鄂圖曼宣戰起，至1812年5月訂《布加勒斯特條約》止，前後約五年半。1807年6月24日（舊曆，新曆7月6日）魯塞克之戰，巴格拉季昂以突襲攻破於斯帕夏的營壘；俄軍自報陣亡約千人、受傷約兩千人，鄂軍損失常被記為陣亡受傷約一萬、被俘約五千，各方數字略有出入。同年在福克沙尼（5月27日舊曆），俄軍渡過阿爾熱什河擊潰鄂軍，鄂軍被俘約一千五百人。1807年6月19至21日（舊曆）阿索斯海戰，俄國黑海分艦隊擊毀鄂軍一支分隊，鄂方損失數艘戰列艦與數千兵力。1808年11月22日（舊曆）滕達拉海戰，鄂軍出動的數十艘艦船被俄艦隊擊沉或擄走，人員傷亡以萬計。陸戰方面，1811年8月19日至9月4日（舊曆）俄軍圍攻並奪取阿克曼，9月4日同日在巴丁擊潰鄂軍；10月16日（舊曆）庫圖佐夫主力渡過多瑙河，10月26至28日（舊曆）斯洛博齊亞之役鄂軍主力覆沒，同月塞爾維亞義軍受降取得貝爾格萊德。1812年5月16日（舊曆，新曆5月28日）兩國在布加勒斯特簽約，鄂圖曼割讓比薩拉比亞及布賈克草原，新國界以普魯特河為界，割地人口約四十萬，數字在史料中略有出入。鄂軍的損失總數已無可靠統計，流傳說法多在數萬至數十萬之間，宜作概數看待。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The war ran from the Ottoman declaration of war in October 1806 to the Treaty of Bucharest in May 1812, about five and a half years. At the battle of Ruse on 24 June 1807, 6 July in the new calendar, Bagration broke Yusuf Pasha's camp by surprise; the Russians gave their own losses as about a thousand killed and about two thousand wounded, and the Ottoman losses are commonly given as about ten thousand killed and wounded with about five thousand captured, the figures varying somewhat from source to source. At Focsani in the same year, on 27 May in the old calendar, the Russians forced the Arges and routed the Ottomans, some fifteen hundred of the enemy being taken prisoner. At the battle of Athos, 19 to 21 June 1807 in the old calendar, the Russian Black Sea squadron destroyed an Ottoman detachment, several ships of the line and several thousand men going down with them. At the battle of Tendra, 22 November 1808 in the old calendar, the dozens of ships the Ottomans sent out were sunk or captured by the Russian squadron, with casualties of order ten thousand men. On land, the Russians besieged and took Akkerman between 19 August and 4 September 1811 in the old calendar and destroyed the Ottoman army at Batin on 4 September; Kutuzov's main body crossed the Danube on 16 October in the old calendar, the Ottoman main army was destroyed at Slobozia on 26 to 28 October, and the Serbs took Belgrade by surrender in the same month. The two powers signed at Bucharest on 16 May 1812, 28 May in the new calendar, the Ottoman Empire ceding Bessarabia and the Budjak steppe and the new frontier running along the Prut; the ceded territory held roughly four hundred thousand inhabitants, the numbers varying somewhat in the sources. No reliable total exists for the Ottoman losses; the figures that circulate range from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands and are best treated as approximations.
cause: 開戰的導火線是塞爾維亞問題。1804年貝爾格萊德的達希雅兄弟被殺，塞爾維亞起義爆發，起義軍在卡拉喬爾季率領下席捲塞爾維亞，並於1806年底攻入貝爾格萊德。俄國在黑海之濱無法直接出兵，便透過聖彼得堡的「塞爾維亞委員會」向義軍輸送金錢與槍械並派駐顧問，甚至假手鄂圖曼境內的商路把軍火運入塞爾維亞；俄國的算盤是削弱鄂圖曼、取得黑海門戶的籌碼，同時在瓦拉幾亞與摩爾多瓦建立影響力。鄂圖曼的反制是1805年廢黜卡拉喬爾季、改立塞利姆帕夏，並要求俄國交出流亡的塞爾維亞首領、停止干預內政。俄國拒絕，談判在英法調停下仍告破裂，鄂圖曼遂於1806年10月宣戰。值得注意的是，英國在1806年與鄂圖曼訂有防禦條約，拿破崙的埃及遠征又使英法在東地中海對峙，這使鄂國在歐洲有了靠山、得以放手在巴爾幹用兵；而俄國在提爾西特之前孤立無援，一旦開戰就只能靠自身力量打到多瑙河。這場戰爭本質上是一場被塞爾維亞起義放大之後的俄土帝國邊界爭奪。
causeEn: The fuse was the Serbian question. In 1804 the Dahija brothers were killed in Belgrade, the Serbian rising began, and under Karadjordje the insurgents swept through Serbia and entered Belgrade at the end of 1806. Russia, unable to send an army openly from the Black Sea, sent money and firearms to the insurgents through the Serbian Committee in St Petersburg, kept advisers on the spot, and even used the trade routes inside Ottoman territory to run arms into Serbia; the object was to weaken the Ottomans, to obtain the key to the Black Sea, and to build influence in Wallachia and Moldavia. The Ottoman answer was to depose Karadjordje in 1805 and install Selim Pasha in his place, and to demand that Russia hand over the exiled Serbian leaders and stop interfering in Ottoman internal affairs. Russia refused; the negotiations broke down under British and French mediation, and the Porte declared war in October 1806. It matters that Britain had concluded a defensive treaty with the Porte in 1806, and that Napoleon's Egyptian expedition set Britain and France against one another in the eastern Mediterranean: the Ottomans had a patron in Europe and could afford to fight out in the Balkans, while Russia, isolated before Tilsit, had to fight her way to the Danube on her own resources. At bottom this was a struggle over the imperial frontier between Russia and the Ottoman Empire, magnified by a Serbian revolt.
impact: 這場戰爭改寫了多瑙河下游的權力地圖。1812年《布加勒斯特條約》把比薩拉比亞與布賈克草原交予俄國，普魯特河成為帝國新的西界，過去屬於摩爾多瓦公國的這片黑土草原此後供給帝國南部小麥，並成為1829年俄土之戰的戰場。塞爾維亞方面，條約雖未在文本上給它法律地位，鄂圖曼卻從塞爾維亞撤走守軍、默許其自治，1806至1813年的第一次塞爾維亞起義因此成為現代塞爾維亞國家的起點；1815年米洛什·奧布倫諾維奇的第二次起義則把塞爾維亞推上實質獨立的道路，歐洲列強在維也納會議前後也逐漸以「自治公國」對待它。門戶問題則一點未解：條約沒有讓俄國戰艦自由通過博斯普魯斯與達達尼爾海峽，鄂圖曼仍倚海峽封鎖黑海，這正是半世紀後克里米亞戰爭爆發的遠因。鄂圖曼方面的代價更為沉重：戰敗直接坐實塞利姆三世改革派與禁軍的失敗，1808年塞利姆三世被廢，馬哈茂德二世以鎮壓禁軍、重建西式軍隊作為開國第一件事，1826年解散禁軍、1829年設立獨立的陸軍省與新式砲兵，鄂國的國家結構由此轉向現代國家。俄國則在1808至1809年被迫把兵力分給對瑞典的戰爭，1812年又因拿破崙入侵而中止戰役、全面西調，說明帝國的戰略重心仍在西面；不過多瑙河的經驗並未白費，1812年6月強渡涅曼河所倚重的舟橋縱列與工程保障，正是這幾年在多瑙河練出來的。
impactEn: This war redrew the political map of the lower Danube. The Treaty of Bucharest of 1812 handed Bessarabia and the Budjak steppe to Russia, and the Prut became the empire's new western limit; the black-earth steppe, formerly part of the principality of Moldavia, henceforth fed the southern provinces of the empire with wheat and became a battlefield of the Russo-Turkish war of 1829. On the Serbian side the treaty gave no legal status, yet the Ottomans withdrew their garrisons from Serbia and acquiesced in its autonomy, so that the rising of 1806 to 1813 became the starting point of the modern Serbian state; the second rising under Milos Obrenovic in 1815 carried the country onto the road to effective independence, and the European powers gradually came to treat it as an autonomous principality around the Congress of Vienna. The question of the straits was settled not at all: the treaty did not open the Bosphorus and the Dardanelles to Russian warships, and the Ottomans still sealed the Black Sea behind the straits, which was a distant cause of the Crimean War half a century later. The Ottoman cost was heavier still: the defeat confirmed the failure of Selim III's reforming party and of the Janissaries, Selim III was deposed in 1808, and Mahmud II made the suppression of the Janissaries and the rebuilding of a western-style army the first business of his reign, dissolving the Janissary corps in 1826 and setting up a separate army department and modern artillery in 1829, so that the Ottoman state structure turned toward the modern state. Russia, for her part, had been forced to split her forces for the war against Sweden in 1808 and 1809, and in 1812 to abandon the campaign and move everything west when Napoleon invaded, which shows that the empire's strategic centre of gravity still lay in the west; the Danube experience was not wasted, however, because the pontoon trains and the engineering support used for the crossing of the Niemen in June 1812 were precisely what had been worked out over these years on the Danube.
result: 最終結果寫在1812年5月16日（舊曆）於布加勒斯特簽訂的條約裡。鄂圖曼割讓比薩拉比亞，以普魯特河為界劃定新邊界，並把多座要塞的歸屬重新安排；俄國取得附帶專有航行權的多瑙河通商利益，同時在條約中與鄂圖曼建立防禦性的軍事關係——這意味著莫斯科與君士坦丁堡在1812年成了同一陣線，而這個條約在六十年後被俄國單方面撕毀時，成為列強交涉中最棘手的法律引據。塞爾維亞未被寫入條約文本，卻取得實質：鄂軍守軍撤走，起義者獲得自治，卡拉喬爾季以塞爾維亞首領身分回國，國家機構在塞爾維亞境內建立，附設的俄國顧問與經費援助延續到1813年。戰爭沒有解決黑海門戶問題，鄂圖曼的海上封鎖與英國的反制照舊；數千平方公里的比薩拉比亞易主，數百萬人口的生計隨國家歸屬而改變；鄂國的西式軍隊改革則在戰敗的刺激下加速推進，禁軍的解散與新軍的建立，讓這場戰爭最終以「帝國崩解的起點」與「俄國邊界的再畫」兩種形式記入史冊。
resultEn: The final result is written into the treaty signed at Bucharest on 16 May 1812 in the old calendar. The Ottoman Empire ceded Bessarabia, the new frontier was drawn along the Prut, and the ownership of several fortresses was rearranged; Russia obtained commercial privileges on the Danube including a right of exclusive navigation, and in the same treaty a defensive military connection was established with the Porte, which meant that Moscow and Constantinople stood in the same camp in 1812, and when Russia unilaterally tore the treaty up sixty years later this became the most awkward legal precedent in the diplomacy of the powers. Serbia was not written into the text of the treaty, but obtained substance: the Ottoman garrisons withdrew, the insurgents obtained autonomy, Karadjordje returned to his country as its head, the state institutions of Serbia were set up, and the Russian advisers and subsidies attached to them continued until 1813. The war settled nothing about the Black Sea: the Ottoman closure of the straits and the British counter-position continued unchanged; several thousand square kilometres of Bessarabia changed hands and the livelihoods of hundreds of thousands of people changed with it; and the reform of the Ottoman western-style army was pushed forward by the sting of the defeat, the dissolution of the Janissaries and the creation of the new army writing the war into history in two forms at once, as the beginning of the break-up of the empire and as a redrawing of the Russian frontier.
